PUBG Mobile is getting a Godzilla collab


In conjunction with the upcoming movie, Godzilla: King of the Monsters, PUBG Mobile will be getting a Godzilla collab!   Another collaboration is here! We are thrilled to announce the crossover between PUBG MOBILE and Godzilla: King of the Monsters! Parachute in to find clues of Godzilla's imminent arrival. See Godzilla: King of the Monsters in theaters May 31st! #PUBGMxGodzilla #GodzillaMovie pic.twitter.com/3PoGZb5rlV



— PUBG MOBILE (@PUBGMOBILE) May 16, 2019

The last time PUGB Mobile got a collab, it was zombie-themed. This time around, you are supposed to be able to find hints of Godzilla’s arrival in the game. But specifics of what this collab will entail has not been revealed. Maybe there will be a mini Godzilla pet? It’s also possible that there will be bonus rewards when logging in daily.

reference_summary: PUBG Mobile telah mengumumkan kerjasama dengan filem akan datang, Godzilla: King of the Monsters. Bermula tidak lama lagi, pemain akan dapat mencari petunjuk ketibaan Godzilla dalam permainan. Walaupun butiran kerjasama itu belum didedahkan, ada kemungkinan akan ada haiwan peliharaan Godzilla mini atau ganjaran log masuk harian. Ikuti PUBG: Halaman Twitter atau Facebook Mudah Alih untuk mendapatkan kemas kini terkini mengenai kerjasama itu.
